author: Stimulating
body:
Well, I'm lft due to Patchi not being able to be active due to mixed timezones, everyone being caught up in OCN and real life, making us unable to scrim often and having restricted scrim times with poor communication, we had no one to shotcall or lead to help. 

You know who I am. I'm very level-headed and calm in scrims, have ridiculous kb, good communication and can do secondary shotcalling. I'm becoming less active due to school, but not that much less active. I can also record.

I'm a Frontlines/Skybridge player, I'm a better skybridger on avi due to my ridiculous connection + kb combination. 

I can defend on Senex if needed, lol.
